about: Race across the endless dunes in SANDSPEED: CAMEL RACING, an action camel racing game where speed and skill determine the champion! Compete in high-speed races and challenging time trials, push your camel to the limit as you dash through desertic landscapes.
- It's not about horsepower, It's about camelpower: Compete against swift rivals or test your reflexes in time-based challenges.
- Sweet "Super" Sweet Watermelons: Snag juicy speed boosts by collecting watermelons on the track.
Master the Desert: Dodge hazards and conquer shifting terrain to stay ahead.
- Feel the Thrill: Experience immersive desert-themed music and realistic racing sound effects.
- Unlock & Explore: Earn achievements, unlock new tracks, and uncover hidden surprises as you climb the tournament.
Are you ready to dominate the dunes and become the ultimate camel racing champion? The race is on!
Enhanced game play on PS4 Pro console
summary: Race across the endless dunes in SANDSPEED: CAMEL RACING, an action camel racing game where speed and skill determine the champion!
